chunks: Commémorate Ishmael in the Book. He was true of his promise, and a messenger, a prophet.

key_terms.رَسُولًا: Messenger (one sent with a specific message/law)
key_terms.صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ: True of his promise / Truthful in keeping commitments

ai.seo_question: What qualities of Prophet Ishmael are highlighted in Surah Mary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the continuity of prophethood within the Abrahamic lineage, linking Ishmael to the eventual arrival of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The distinction between 'Rasul' (messenger with a new law) and 'Nabi' (prophet receiving revelation) underscores his unique spiritual authority. This praise reinforces the concept of 'Siddiq' (truthfulness) as a core attribute of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams.
